title: Elon Musk Plans 2027 Launch Of Nvidia VR NLV72 AI Computers In Space

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The provider of Falcon rockets intends to position high-density GPU clusters above the atmosphere within the coming year to expand artificial intelligence processing capabilities. Elon Musk stated he is "highly confident" that the Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 AI computers will be operational in space by 2027. The deployment will create an orbiting AI compute infrastructure to handle high-performance workloads.

The initiative utilizes the Vera Rubin architecture to establish a new frontier for computing outside the Earth's atmosphere. This project integrates Nvidia's hardware into the SpaceX orbital payload schedule to facilitate space-based AI processing.
